about: What a photographer may change in the Northlight design. Protected: the scroll-run studio where one frame is lit light by light (backdrop, key, fill, rim, background, then the shot and the print) beside its lighting diagram and viewfinder; shot.subject picks a profile portrait or a product bottle and shot.look the grade (warm, mono or cool); the sessions and packages, the timeline, the date calendar, layout, type and all interaction code. The photographer's own words, settings, packages, timeline and diary come from the content.
rules: Text may not contain < > { } or line breaks.

shot: the frame the hero lights: subject (portrait: a profile lit with key, fill and rim; product: a bottle with strip-light reflections and a label from product.name and product.line), look (the grade: warm, mono for black and white, cool), the camera settings shown, the lighting ratio (3:1), frames shot and keepers, and the caption on the print.
stages: six steps, in order: the backdrop, key light, fill, rim light, background, the frame. Each a short name and a caption.

sessions.kinds: one to four kinds of shoot, each with a line and one to three packages: name, price (from: true when it can grow), time, photos delivered, up to five things included and an optional tag (Most booked). sessions.start: the kind and package picked at first.
process.steps: three to six steps with when they happen; process.delivers: up to three numbers that matter (48 h, 2 weeks).

book: lead is the soonest a date can be held, in days; closed days are never offered (0 Sunday to 6 Saturday). The calendar sends a real request: the photographer replies to confirm and hold the date. Never say a date is held or booked.
